label: write release note
prompt:
You are tasked to generate release notes for the app called vidsy-pipes.

* these release notes should be directed towards the end user:
  * keep it simple and very short, no details
  * never mention anything about internal workings, nothing about release methods, internal scripts,...
*  Before you can render these notes, you need to know the current version. This can be read from the file \`{{rootProjectFolder}}\desktop\package.json\`.
* All release notes are stored as markdown files in the folders with name \`releases\\{VERSION}\`, where version is read from package.json, dots (.) replaced with lines (\_)
* all features descriptions jobs, and bug fixes that need to be included in the release, can be found at \`releases\\{VERSION}\`, where version is read from package.json, dots (.) replaced with lines (\_)
*  The release note should be saved at \`C:\Users\janbo\Documents\dev\vidsy\website\docs\release notes\\{version}.md\`. 

  - See the content of this folder on how to format the filename

\- the release note is a markdown file that will be used in a docusaurus website, so it should have a header with 

  - title 

  - description

  - version

  - releaseDate (today)

  - summary

  - sidebar\_position (always 1, the position of all previous versions should be incremented by 1)

\- use single bullet points to describe each new feature. keep it short no detailed explanation needed.

\- don't mention technical details of the models like architecture.
